task.task: Assess the evidence and explain your decision before setting approved. Independently decide whether this proposed configuration repair is justified. Approve only when every action restores the declared intended state of an evidence-backed fault on the same device and target, with no unrelated changes. Reject an empty or incomplete plan, unsupported evidence, a wrong device/target/value, or an action that introduces a fault. A permitted restorative change is not disruptive merely because it changes configuration. Do not require physical hardware failure evidence: link_down means measured administrative state is down. Use the action semantics below and cite measured evidence IDs. Policy, twin equivalence, recovery and regression checks remain mandatory after your decision; your approval alone never authorizes execution. Check the exact action set against required_restorative_actions and measured evidence. Do not reject because an address is currently absent or an interface is currently DOWN: those are the diagnosed conditions being restored.
